# spokes-api/types/selectors/v1/quarantine_commits_selector.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.selectors.v1.QuarantineCommitsSelector"></a>

### QuarantineCommitsSelector
QuarantineCommitsSelector is a selector for selecting commits that were
included in a transaction (e.g. a push) specifically while they are still in
quarantine.
